# Code of Conduct

Isometric follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be welcoming, be respectful, assume good intent, and focus on what is best for the community. Harassment, discrimination and personal attacks are not tolerated in issues, pull requests or any other project space.

Report unacceptable behaviour privately through a [GitHub security advisory](https://github.com/Abhishek-Mallick/Isometric/security/advisories/new) or by contacting [@Abhishek-Mallick](https://github.com/Abhishek-Mallick). All reports are handled confidentially.
